newsitem.title: USA: Philip Morris says Bring named vice chairman.
newsitem.headline: Philip Morris says Bring named vice chairman.

text.p: Philip Morris Cos Inc said Wednesday that Murray Bring has been elected to the posts of vice chairman, external affairs and general counsel, and that William Webb has been elected to the new position of chief operating officer.
The company said that as COO, Webb will be responsible for the management of the its major business units.
The company also said it named Andreas Gembler president and chief executive officer of Philip Morris International Inc, the position formerly held by Webb, effective immediately.
Bring joined Philip Morris in January, 1988 as associate general counsel. Prior to joining Philip Morris, he was a senior partner with the law firm of Arnold & Porter.
Webb joined Philip Morris in 1966 and has held held numerous senior management positions.
Prior to being named to his new position, Gembler had been president of the Eastern Europe, Middle East and Africa region for Philip Morris International Inc. since 1990.
